
# Research Lab

I direct a research lab focused on the politics of state repression, concentration camps, and systems of mass detention. We work with quantitative and qualitative data, geospatial analysis, and archival materials.

## Opportunities for students

I frequently work with undergraduate and graduate research assistants on:

-   Data collection and coding
-   Archival and document research
-   R-based data analysis and visualization
-   Writing and revising manuscripts and policy-oriented pieces

If you are an LSU student interested in working with the lab, please fill out the form below.\
I will review submissions periodically and contact students as opportunities become available.
